title: Heartbeat rollout for Optimize batching & cache recommendations
creator: Sophie Patel
description: Implement a conservative, observable "heartbeat" rollout mechanism to auto-apply Optimize recommendations (batching + prefix/KV cache configs) safely. Goals: (1) reduce per-token cost for eligible routes by applying suggested batching and cache profiles, (2) avoid customer-facing regressions by running controlled pulses with automated health gating, (3) provide clear audit trail and manual approval hooks for security/compliance-sensitive tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pulse runner can apply a recommendation to a targeted route and revert within 5 minutes if safety checks fail
Canary window telemetry (latency P95, error rate, token cost delta) surfaces in the Console dashboard for every pulse
Manual approval flow available to block auto-apply for routes with `enterprise: true` label
End-to-end tests exercising KV cache priming, cold-start latency, and batch sizing passed on CI with <=10% regression allowance
rollout_plan: Phase 0: dry-run only for internal test tenants (1 day). Phase 1: 1% traffic pulse on low-risk routes for 24h. Phase 2: progressive pulses (1% -> 5% -> 20%) over 72h with monitoring gates at each step. Phase 3: full route apply with 7-day observation. Each pulse is a 'heartbeat' action that lasts 30 minutes and reverts unless a subsequent heartbeat confirms stability.
canary_policy: Pulse size increases: 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Each pulse requires: latency P95 within +10% of baseline OR improved, error rate delta <= +0.1% absolute, cost-per-token improved >= 3%. Warmup: ensure KV-cache hitrate >= 60% within first 15 minutes or fail the pulse. If route is stateful (session affinity) use sticky routing for pulse users to avoid cross-contamination.
rollback_criteria: Immediate rollback if any monitoring check breaches during a pulse. Also rollback if user-facing error incidents are reported via Sentry or if synthetic traffic (canary probes) show degraded structured outputs for 2 consecutive check intervals. Rollback must be automated and take <2 minutes to complete.
test_plan: Unit tests for config apply/revert; integration test simulating KV cache cold->hot transition; e2e harness that runs pulses against staging routes; chaos test injecting slow nodes to validate rollback triggers. Test artifacts: Confluence design doc + GH actions matrix.
notes: 2026-03-02: Initial spike completed; CPU binding issues observed with large batch sizes — reduced max batch cap to 128 for safety
